blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) is probing another company allegedly linked to Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband, Atty. Manases Carpio, as part of its inquiry into her alleged “unexplained wealth,” Director Melvin Matibag said. Matibag identified the company as Westgate88, which he said was allegedly named after Duterte-Carpio associates. READ: NBI refers discrepancy in Sara Duterte SALN to Ombudsman According to Matibag, Westgate88 is “a relatively new company with several land assets.” He also mentioned two lawyers, one allegedly associated with Duterte-Carpio Law Offices and the other serving as Westgate88’s president. “We saw their involvement […]...
